_readme: Every entry below comes directly from the company's own profile document (M.J. Oswal Exports Pvt. Ltd.) — quantities are not estimates. To add a new machine: copy one object inside 'items', keep every key, add an image under /assets/images/machines/ (or reuse a real photo already in the project), and re-run scripts/build_site.py.

items.name: Circular Knitting Machines
items.description: High-speed, computerised machines for consistent fabric quality and output.
items.details: 20 circular knitting machines (plus 2 interlock knitting machines) form the core of our in-house fabric production.

items.name: Interlock Knitting Machines
items.description: Dedicated interlock machines running alongside our circular knitting line.
items.details: 2 interlock knitting machines, high-speed and computerised for consistent fabric quality and output.

items.name: Flat Knitting Machines
items.description: For specialised fabrics that need precision and versatility.
items.details: 4 flat knitting machines, used for specialised fabric constructions outside our circular knitting range.

items.name: Automatic Screen Printing Machines
items.description: High-quality prints with flexibility for a wide range of designs.
items.details: 11 automatic screen printing machines, plus 1 manual printing machine, supporting up to 7–8 colours per print.

items.name: Manual Printing Machine
items.description: Flexible manual printing for smaller or specialised runs.
items.details: 1 manual printing machine, working alongside our 11 automatic screen printing machines.

items.name: Gas Curing Machines
items.description: Ensures proper curing for long-lasting prints.
items.details: 2 gas curing machines, used to cure prints for durability and colour fastness.

items.name: Fusing Machines
items.description: Perfect application for stickers, patches and heat transfers.
items.details: 4 fusing machines, used for applying stickers and patches to finished garments.

items.name: Laser Cutting Machine
items.description: Accurate and clean cutting for printed fabrics.
items.details: 1 laser cutting machine, used for precise, clean cutting of printed fabric panels.

items.name: Plotter Machine
items.description: For precise plotting and design handling.
items.details: 1 plotter machine, supporting our design and pre-print preparation process.

items.name: Multi-Head Embroidery Machines
items.description: For faster turnaround and consistency across every production run.
items.details: Multi-head embroidery machines for high-speed, efficient embroidery, from small logos to complex, detailed patterns.
